description.en: Runs the full "item obtained" presentation: fades out the BGM, plays a jingle, shows the item-get message (with the item substituted into it), adds the item to the inventory, then restores the BGM. The general engine behind RunGetItem/RunGetWadai/RunGetImportantItem.
Item ID to obtain and substitute into the message.
Quantity of the item to add.
BGM fade-out duration in frames before the sequence.
Number of frames to wait after the BGM fade before starting.
Jingle sound event ID to play.
Message substitution slot index for the item.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Obtain an item with the standard presentation (as RunGetItem does internally)
RunGetItemEx("irg0001", 1, 30, 30, "J_08", 0, "sysmes-item-get");
